Passed on five higher-scoring candidates on this screen, each disqualified for a specific, dated reason: ASTS (still no news addressing the 10/13 Piper Sandler SpaceX-competitive-threat downgrade that triggered our 10/16 exit -- re-buy restriction stands), RCAT (CRO retaliation lawsuit from the 7/21 for-cause termination remains unresolved, no October update), SERV (Uber Eats non-renewal now confirmed executed -- Grubhub/DoorDash diversification is real but FY26 guidance cut to $9-10M stands, stock down ~45% over the past year), ZENA (a fresh October 2026 Form 424B5 offering at $1.35/share confirms, rather than resolves, the dilution concern flagged at the 10/14 pass), and IONQ (no news since 10/14 addressing the Elisity-deal/dilutive-raise strategic-drift concern behind our 10/14 exit; the ~35.8M new shares for Elisity, ~9% of shares out, confirm the dilution is material).
